title: Claude 3 Opus and Sonnet Release
summary: Anthropic announced the Claude 3 model family on March 4, 2024 and made Claude 3 Opus and Claude 3 Sonnet available that day through claude.ai and the Claude API; Claude 3 Haiku was announced as coming soon.
significance: A dated public announcement and availability milestone for Claude 3 Opus and Claude 3 Sonnet.

verification.note: Anthropic's first-party announcement is dated March 4, 2024, announces the Claude 3 family, and states that Opus and Sonnet were available that day while Haiku would be available soon. This candidate records only the dated announcement/availability milestone and does not treat Haiku as released on March 4 or infer development geography, ancestry, influence, causality, priority, or relationship edges.

sources.title: Introducing the next generation of Claude
